preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The number of extra edges added to the tree is between 0 and 4, inclusive.
Each extra edge connects two distinct nodes within the tree.
No self-loops are present in the extra edges.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of simple paths in the resulting graph, modulo 10^9 + 7.
